generator.program.note: The lineage's own program (growth plan G2.3a), on the herb base: it gives the values its species leave unset, which the herb program gave as defaults until then.

traits.note: Abrams's Illustrated Flora of the Pacific States, volume 3 (1951), read in full (Scrophulariaceae by Pennell, Mimulus): calyx tubular, plicate-angled, 5-toothed; corolla tubular, two-lipped, the upper lip 2-lobed and the lower 3-lobed; stamens 4, didynamous; stigma 2-lobed. Jepson eFlora and the Flora of Tasmania (as quoted in search results; the pages themselves were not read): flowers hypogynous, ovary superior, of 2 carpels.

traits.woodiness.note: Hutchinson (vol. 1, 2nd ed., 1959), family 246 Phrymaceae (Phryma alone), with the monkeyflowers he keeps in Scrophulariaceae, which APG joins as Phrymaceae: herbs; leaves opposite, simple; stipules absent.
